Getting started with roadmappeR

Source: vignettes/roadmappeR.Rmd
roadmappeR.Rmd
library(roadmappeR)

general idea

A roadmap is based on a set of milestones. Each one sits on a track of readiness levels (TRL, MRL, FRL, or anything you like), and is either on a fixed date, or x months after one or more other milestones.

Everything is stored in one plain csv file, see ?"milestones-format".

Start from the example 

csv <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
file.copy(roadmap_example(), csv)
#> [1] TRUE
ms <- read_milestones(csv)
ms[, c("id", "date", "after", "status")]
#>      id       date          after   status
#> 1  TRL3 2026-01-15                achieved
#> 2  TRL4 2026-09-30                achieved
#> 3  TRL5                   TRL4:12  planned
#> 4  TRL6                   TRL5:10  planned
#> 5  TRL7            TRL6:14;MRL6:1  planned
#> 6  MRL3 2026-03-01                achieved
#> 7  MRL4                    TRL4:5  planned
#> 8  MRL5                    TRL5:3  planned
#> 9  MRL6                    MRL5:9  planned
#> 10 FRL2 2026-02-01                achieved
#> 11 FRL4                    TRL4:2  planned
#> 12 FRL5                    FRL4:9  planned
#> 13 FRL6            FRL5:12;TRL6:3  planned

after reads “after TRL 6 by 14 months and after MRL 6 by 1 month” for TRL6:14;MRL6:1. Dates are computed from these rules:

r <- resolve_milestones(ms)
r[r$id %in% c("TRL5", "TRL7", "FRL6"), c("id", "when", "driver")]
#>      id       when driver
#> 3  TRL5 2027-09-30   TRL4
#> 5  TRL7 2029-09-30   TRL6
#> 13 FRL6 2028-10-30   TRL6

driver is the dependency that decides the date, shown as the dark arrow.

Plot 

plot_roadmap(ms)

Hover a point to see its date, dependencies and comment (which may have several lines).

Move things around

In the app you drag points. In code, the same operation is move_milestone(). Moving a dependent milestone rewrites the lag of its longest dependency; everything after it follows.

res <- move_milestone(ms, "TRL7", "2029-11-30")
res$df$after[res$df$id == "TRL7"]
#> [1] "TRL6:16;MRL6:1"

A move that would break a dependency is refused:

move_milestone(ms, "TRL7", "2028-09-01")$message
#> [1] "TRL7 can't be earlier than MRL6 + 1 months (= 2028-10-30)."

The interactive app 

run_roadmap(csv)
  • Drag a point sideways to move it.
  • Click a point to edit label, status, dependencies and comment.
  • Add milestones, or a new track by typing a new track name.

Every change is saved straight to the CSV, keeping only the latest state.

Share the current status 

export_snapshot(csv, "roadmap_snapshot.html")

This writes one self-contained HTML file with hover but no editing.
